mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getStandardNotSunapList */ select gc.elctrn_pay_no enapbu_no , gsb.mng_htm5 book_no , gc.cntr_locgov_code jijache_cd , gc.cntr_amt *(select point_rate from g_ctbny_setup where locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code and stdr_year = DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y') )/100 as user_cntr_point , gc.rtnpsnt_reqst_code present_type from g_cntr gc inner join gif_stnd_buga_now gsb on gc.elctrn_pay_no = gsb.elct_pay_no where gc.sttemnt_pay_de is null and gc.delete_at = 'N' and gc.seoul_trget_at = 'N' and gc.pay_valid_de > DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d')

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getNtsEreceiptNotList */ select user_id , locgov_code , tax_amt , sttemnt_pay_de , user_ci , biz_no , enapbu_no from ( select gc.frst_register_id user_id , gc.cntr_locgov_code locgov_code , gc.cntr_amt tax_amt , gc.sttemnt_pay_de , (select mber_ci from op_user where user_id = gc.user_id ) user_ci , (select bizrno from g_locgov where locgov_code = gc.cntr_locgov_code ) biz_no , gc.elctrn_pay_no enapbu_no from g_cntr gc where gc.sttemnt_pay_de is not null and gc.cntr_sttus_code = '200' and gc.cntr_path_code = #{cntrPathCode} and gc.delete_at = 'N' and gc.sttemnt_pay_de = TO_CHAR(ADDDATE( SYSDATETIME , INTERVAL -1 DAY), 'yyyymmdd') and (gc.nts_sttus_mssage is null OR gc.nts_sttus_mssage = 'null') order by gc.cntr_de ) where rownum <= 100 AND user_ci IS NOT null

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getHonorCntrLevel */ SELECT GL.LOCGOV_CODE ,GL.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM ,GL.LOCGOV_NM ,#{userId} AS USER_ID ,(SELECT MBER_CI FROM OP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS MBER_CI ,(SELECT CRYPTO_DEC('normal', USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME FROM OP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS USER_NAME ,(SELECT RECEIVE_SMS FROM OP_USER_DETAIL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS RECEIVE_SMS ,(SELECT REPLACE (CRYPTO_DEC('normal',PHONE_NUMBER, '', 0),'-','') FROM OP_USER_DETAIL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS PHONE_NUMBER ,NVL(( SELECT ( CASE WHEN SUM(CNTR_AMT) >= STDR_3LEVEL_AMT THEN '300' WHEN SUM(CNTR_AMT) >= STDR_2LEVEL_AMT THEN '200' WHEN SUM(CNTR_AMT) >= STDR_1LEVEL_AMT THEN '100' ELSE '0' END ) FROM G_CNTR WHERE YEAR(STTEMNT_PAY_DE) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GL.LOCGOV_CODE AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL ), 0) AS CODE ,NVL(( SELECT HONOR_CNTRBTR_LEVEL_CODE FROM G_HONOR_CNTRBTR WHERE STDR_YEAR = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND LOCGOV_CODE = GL.LOCGOV_CODE ), 0) AS HONOR_CNTRBTR_LEVEL_CODE FROM G_LOCGOV GL WHERE GL.LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND ( GL.STDR_1LEVEL_AMT >= 100 OR GL.STDR_2LEVEL_AMT >= 100 OR GL.STDR_3LEVEL_AMT >= 100 )

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.selectUserCntrLocgovForNhList */ SELECT a.user_id AS userId , b.mber_ci AS mberCi , a.sttemnt_pay_de AS sttemntPayDe , a.cntr_locgov_code AS cntrLocgovCode , NVL(CAST(cntr_amt AS bigint), 0) AS cntrAmt FROM ( SELECT a.user_id , a.sttemnt_pay_de , a.cntr_locgov_code , sum(a.cntr_amt) as cntr_amt FROM g_cntr a WHERE a.delete_at = 'N' AND a.sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND a.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND a.sttemnt_pay_de <= #{sttemntPayDe} GROUP BY a.user_id, a.sttemnt_pay_de, a.cntr_locgov_code ) a INNER JOIN op_user b ON a.user_id = b.user_id and b.mber_ci is not null

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getNoBugaLocgovList */ WITH locgov AS ( SELECT upper_locgov_code , locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_nm FROM g_locgov WHERE use_at = 'Y' ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT upper_locgov_code , locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_nm , sum(seo_cnt) AS seo_cnt , sum(con_cnt) AS con_cnt FROM ( SELECT upper_locgov_code , locgov_code , upper_locgov_nm , locgov_nm , 0 AS seo_cnt , 0 AS con_cnt FROM locgov UNION ALL SELECT a.upper_locgov_code , a.locgov_code , a.upper_locgov_nm , a.locgov_nm , count(b.cntr_sn) AS seo_cnt , 0 as con_cnt FROM g_locgov a INNER JOIN g_cntr b ON a.locgov_code = b.cntr_locgov_code AND b.delete_at ='N' AND b.sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND b.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND b.cntr_de between DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SYSDATETIME, interval-3 day), '%Y%m%d') and TO_CHAR(SYSDATETIME, 'yyyymmdd') AND b.seoul_trget_at = 'Y' GROUP BY upper_locgov_code, a.locgov_code, a.upper_locgov_nm, a.locgov_nm UNION ALL SELECT a.upper_locgov_code , a.locgov_code , a.upper_locgov_nm , a.locgov_nm , 0 as seo_cnt , count(b.cntr_sn) AS con_cnt FROM g_locgov a INNER JOIN g_cntr b ON a.locgov_code = b.cntr_locgov_code AND b.delete_at ='N' AND b.sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND b.cntr_sttus_code = '200' AND b.cntr_de between DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SYSDATETIME, interval-3 day), '%Y%m%d') and TO_CHAR(SYSDATETIME, 'yyyymmdd') AND b.seoul_trget_at = 'N' GROUP BY upper_locgov_code, a.locgov_code, a.upper_locgov_nm, a.locgov_nm ) a GROUP BY upper_locgov_code, a.locgov_code, a.upper_locgov_nm, a.locgov_nm ) a where (a.locgov_code like '11%' AND seo_cnt = 0) OR (substring(locgov_code ,0, 2) != '11' AND con_cnt = 0)

mapper.insert: /* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.insertNextBugaCntr */ INSERT INTO G_CNTR( CNTR_SN, CNTR_DE, USER_ID, PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_AMT, CNTR_POINT, PAY_VALID_DE, CNTR_PATH_CODE, CNTR_STTUS_CODE, ELCTRN_PAY_NO, SEOUL_TRGET_AT, INFO_AGRE_AT, RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, DELETE_AT, FOREIGN_STATUS_CODE, DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID ) VALUES( #{linkMngKey}, #{lvyYmd}, #{userId}, #{psitnLocgovCode}, #{cntrLocgovCode}, #{frstPctAmt}, 0, #{lvyYmd}, '100', '100', #{epayNo}, 'N', '1', #{presentType}, #{userId}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), 'N', #{foreignStatusCode}, #{prjId} )
mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getSunapInfo */ SELECT COUNT(*) as CNT FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1=1 AND ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{elctrnPayNo} AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND DELETE_AT = 'N'

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getCntrNonSunapDataList */ SELECT GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO AS ENAPBU_NO ,GSR.RCVMT_YMD AS STTEMNT_PAY_DE ,GC.CNTR_SN AS LINK_MNG_KEY ,(SELECT ORDER_CODE FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM WHERE FILLER9 = GC.CNTR_SN LIMIT 1) AS ORDER_CODE FROM G_CNTR GC INNER JOIN G_NEXT_SUNAP_RESPONSE GSR ON GC.CNTR_SN = GSR.LINK_MNG_KEY WHERE GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '100' AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE IS NOT NULL AND GC.CNTR_DE >= '20240101' ORDER BY GC.CNTR_DE DESC LIMIT 200

/* saleson.shop.offgive.NgDonationMapper.getGCntrSumCntrAmt */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT), 0) AS MAX_CNTR_AMT FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1=1 AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(CNTR_DE) = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y')

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.selectTodayCntrSigunguCnt */ SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM G_CNTR CN inner join G_LOCGOV L on L.LOCGOV_CODE = CN.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE where 1=1 and CN.STTEMNT_PAY_DE is not null and CN.DELETE_AT = 'N' and CN.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' and cn.cntr_de = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m%d') and cn.cntr_locgov_code = #{locgovCode} and cn.user_id = #{userId}

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getTodayCntrListInfo */ SELECT a.cntr_sn, DATE_FORMAT(a.cntr_de, '%Y.%m.%d') as cntr_de, c.locgov_code, c.upper_locgov_nm, c.locgov_nm, a.cntr_amt, a.cntr_point, a.cntr_blce_point, a.elctrn_pay_no, case when a.sttemnt_pay_de is not null and cntr_sttus_code = '200' then DATE_FORMAT(a.sttemnt_pay_de, '%Y.%m.%d') else '납부결과확인' end as sttemnt_pay_de, case when a.sttemnt_pay_de is not null and cntr_sttus_code = '200' then 1 else 2 end as sttemnt_pay_de_case, a.cntr_locgov_code, case when substr(a.cntr_locgov_code,1,2) = '11' then (select to_char(sysdatetime, 'hh24missFF') || lpad(random() % 1000, 3, 0)) else (select mng_htm5 from gif_stnd_buga_now where elct_pay_no = a.elctrn_pay_no) end as mng_no, (select point_rate from g_ctbny_setup where locgov_code = a.cntr_locgov_code and stdr_year = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y')) as point_rate , A.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID AS PRJ_ID , IFNULL(DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_TTL, '자치단체기부') AS PRJ_SUBJECT , D.DETAIL , A.LINK_INSTT_CD FROM OP_USER B JOIN G_CNTR A ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID JOIN G_LOCGOV C ON A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = C.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG DPM ON A.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE D ON D.ID = A.LINK_INSTT_CD AND D.CODE_TYPE = 'LINK_INSTT_CD' WHERE A.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND B.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.cntr_locgov_code = #{locgovCode} AND a.cntr_de = DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE,'%Y%m%d')

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getCntrNonSunapFiveMinList */ SELECT GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO AS ENAPBU_NO ,GC.CNTR_SN AS CNTR_SN ,GC.CNTR_DE AS CNTR_DE ,GC.SEOUL_TRGET_AT AS SEOUL_TRGET_AT ,GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AS CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ,GC.USER_ID AS USER_ID ,GC.CNTR_AMT AS CNTR_AMT ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OU.LOGIN_ID , '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OU.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME FROM G_CNTR GC INNER JOIN OP_USER OU ON GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID WHERE GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '100' AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE IS NOT NULL AND GC.SUNAP_PROCSS_YN = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_DE >= TO_CHAR(ADDDATE( SYSDATETIME , INTERVAL -1 DAY), 'yyyymmdd') ORDER BY GC.CNTR_DE DESC LIMIT 200

/* saleson.shop.donation.NgDonationMapper.getCntrNonSunapAlldayList */ SELECT GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO AS ENAPBU_NO ,GC.CNTR_SN AS CNTR_SN ,GC.CNTR_DE AS CNTR_DE ,GC.SEOUL_TRGET_AT AS SEOUL_TRGET_AT ,GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AS CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ,GC.USER_ID AS USER_ID ,GC.CNTR_AMT AS CNTR_AMT ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OU.LOGIN_ID , '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OU.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME FROM G_CNTR GC INNER JOIN OP_USER OU ON GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID WHERE GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '100' AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE IS NOT NULL AND GC.CNTR_DE >= TO_CHAR(ADDDATE(SYSDATETIME , INTERVAL -7 DAY), 'yyyymmdd') ORDER BY GC.CNTR_DE DESC
